card.title: EAST SURREY REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The East Surrey Regiment was first formed in 1881 and participated in The Second Boer War, WWI and WWII. In 1939 the 1st Battalion of the East Surrey Regiment was part of the 11th Infantry Brigade of the 4th Infantry Division which was sent to France as part of the British Expeditionary Force. After the evacuation from Dunkirk the regiment spent two years in the UK on home defense duty, preparing for a German invasion. In 1942 the regiment and the rest of the 11th Brigade became part of the 78th Battleaxe Infantry Division which participated in Operation Torch and landed in Algiers as part of the British First Army. In 1943 they fought with the British Eight Army in the Italian Campaign and participated in the Battle of Termoli and saw combat at the Barbara Line and River Sangro. In 1944 the division participated in the fourth and final battle of Monte Cassino and in the winter they participated in Operation Olive where they fought against the German forces in the Apennine Mountains. Finally the regiment fought with the 78th Division in the spring offensive of 1945 and ended the war in Austria.
